headings: Placing Customer Places a Sales Order - Through CSR
text: If Customer wants to modify the order Customer contacts CSR. Customer may request to add items, remove items, change quantities, change sizes/colors, change address, change shipping method, change billing info, add gift message. If new order grand total is greater than the original (before the requested changes) and the order is paid by credit card, Company automatically cancels original authorization and authorizes the new grand total. If that authorization fails CSR is notified and contacts Customer to resolve. Customer may request other changes to resolve issue and CSR will "re-finalize" the order to do a new authorization.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
